summary: A static light-grey (#fbfbfb) closing section 1252x606 in three horizontal bands. Top band (y 0-76) is empty apart from a faint field of vertical hairline stripes spanning x≈115-1140, closed by a 1px light-grey rule at y≈76. Middle CTA band (y 76-365): on the left a two-line near-black serif headline "Ready to / Get Started?" (~46px, x 117) above two square-cornered 40px buttons, a solid blue (#0097fb) "Try Boomtax Free" and a white, thinly bordered "Book a Demo". The right two-thirds hold an isometric line illustration (x≈455-1077, y≈128-325): five white extruded badge tiles (HIPAA card, round AICPA SOC 2 puck, a long CERTIFIED bar in the centre, COMODO card, IRS card, PCI DSS card) with soft grey sides and small round port dots, all joined by thin 1px grey stepped/zig-zag wires. Bottom footer band (y 365-606) sits under another rule; its side margins (x 0-115 and 1135-1252) are filled with the same vertical hairline stripes. Footer content: serif "Boomtax" wordmark ("tax" heavier) with "© 2025. BoomTax - All rights reserved." under it, then four link columns (Product, Forms, Support, Tools) with serif headings at y≈424 and grey sans links on a 28px rhythm; the Tools column runs off the bottom edge. The only motion: short blue light pulses (about 20-60px long) run along the grey connector wires between badges all through the clip, several at once on different wires. The wire turns blue where a pulse passes and goes grey again after it. Layout, text, badges and buttons never move. Frame-wide faint edge flicker in the difference views is video compression, not motion.

criteria.check: Background is a flat near-white light grey (~#fbfbfb), no gradient
A full-width 1px light grey horizontal rule sits at y≈76
A second full-width 1px light grey rule sits at y≈365 separating CTA band from footer
The top band (y 0-76) shows faint vertical hairline stripes spanning roughly x 115-1140, with plain background left of x 115
Stripes are very faint thin vertical lines (barely darker than the background), not solid bars or a dark pattern
Footer side margins (x 0-115 and x 1135-1252, y 366-606) are filled with the same faint vertical stripes while the footer content area between them is plain
Headline reads exactly 'Ready to' on line 1 and 'Get Started?' on line 2
Headline is a near-black serif face at ~46px cap-to-descender, regular weight
Headline left edge at x≈117, first line top ≈148, second line baseline ≈232
Blue button box about x 116-248, y 254-294 (132x40), left-aligned with the headline
Primary button fill is a solid saturated blue ~#0097fb with square or near-square (≤3px) corners
Primary button label reads 'Try Boomtax Free' in white sans ~14px
Secondary button sits right of the primary with ~9px gap, about x 257-361, same 40px height
Secondary button is white with a very faint 1px grey border, square corners
Secondary button reads 'Book a Demo' in dark near-black sans
Illustration occupies about x 455-1077, y 128-325, right of the CTA text
Exactly six badge objects are visible: HIPAA card, round SOC 2 puck, CERTIFIED bar, COMODO card, IRS card, PCI DSS card
Badges are drawn in isometric projection as white extruded slabs with light grey shaded side faces and thin grey outlines, no heavy drop shadows
HIPAA card top-left of the illustration at about x 507-659, y 130-225
HIPAA card shows a blue outlined pill logo with padlock icon and 'HIPAA COMPLIANT', an original drawing with the same blue colour and silhouette
SOC 2 badge is a round cylindrical puck (not a slab) with a blue and black ring seal reading 'AICPA SOC 2'
Centre bar carries the word 'CERTIFIED' in dark serif type along its top face, angled up to the right
CERTIFIED bar is a long tall extruded block with small round port dots on its end faces
Top-right card shows a red padlock mark and red 'COMODO' word
Lower-middle card shows a black IRS logo (eagle with horizontal lines and 'IRS')
Right card shows a dark green 'PCI' mark with green check and 'DSS COMPLIANT'
Badges are linked by thin ~1px grey lines that run in stepped zig-zag paths between small round port dots
Wires are plain hairlines: no arrows, no dashes, no thick tubes
At least two short blue segments are visible on different grey wires at the same moment
A pulse is the wire itself turning blue over a short stretch (~20-60px), same 1px width and soft fading ends, not a dot, glow blob or thick bar
Blue segments are on different wires/positions between 1.6s and 2.1s (e.g. on the IRS-PCI wire near x 895-945 at 1.6s and on the SOC2-CERTIFIED and IRS left wires near x 625-770 at 2.1s)
Pulses travel along the wire paths (following their bends) rather than fading in and out in place
Between 3.0s and 3.4s the pulse on the COMODO wire (near x 790-845, y 185-200) has shifted position along the wire
Pulses run continuously across the whole clip: some wire carries blue at 0.5s, 1s, 2.1s, 2.5s, 3s and 3.4s
After a pulse passes, the wire behind it returns to plain grey (no permanent blue trail builds up)
The badge tiles themselves do not move, scale or change between 1.6s and 3.4s
Headline, buttons and footer text stay fixed for the whole clip; only the wire pulses change
Footer wordmark reads 'Boomtax' in near-black serif, with 'tax' set heavier than 'Boom'
Wordmark left edge at x≈145, vertical centre ≈427
Under the wordmark reads exactly '© 2025. BoomTax - All rights reserved.' in mid-grey sans ~14px
Exactly four link columns with headings 'Product', 'Forms', 'Support', 'Tools' in that order left to right
Column headings start at x≈459, 581, 744 and 871 on a shared line at y≈424
Column headings are near-black serif ~18px; links beneath are lighter grey sans ~14px
Product links read 'Home', 'Features', 'Pricing', 'Login'
Forms links read 'ACA Forms', '1099 Forms', 'W-2 Forms', 'Pay Data Reporting'
Support links read 'Tax News', 'Knowledgebase', 'Chat', 'Contact Us'
Tools links read 'Do I need to file ACA?', 'Do I need to file CA Pay Data Reports?', 'ACA Code Series 1', 'ACA Code Series 2', 'Employee vs Contractor', 'Do I need to file a BOI Report'
Link rows are spaced ~28px apart starting at y≈456 (456, 484, 512, 540, ...)
The sixth Tools link sits at y≈596 and is cut off by the bottom frame edge
